method: Replay the frozen accepted mesh and resample it with a development-only natural cubic spline using optimization barriers at scalar arithmetic steps in the Thomas solve, coefficient construction, and Horner evaluation. Compare full eager/JIT coarse and fine states with the unchanged resampler and reference trajectory.
interpretation: One-chart state-resampling control only. A pass does not establish whole-waveform, AD/FD, source-fidelity across cases, or release qualification.
